newsitem.title: UK: DFS places 20 pct of shares at 533p each.
newsitem.headline: DFS places 20 pct of shares at 533p each.

text.p: DFS Furniture Co Plc said on Monday that the family of executive chairman Graham Kirkham had placed 20.98 million shares, representing 20 percent of the share capital, with institutions and other investors at 533p a share.

The placement, which the company said was brokered by NatWest Wood Mackenzie & Co, had been flagged two weeks ago when company founder Kirkham said his children and some family trusts were looking at a possible sale of much of their DFS holding.
As indicated at that time, Kirkham said in Monday's statement that he had not sold any of his personal shareholding.

"Following the placing, Sir Graham Kirkham and his children will remain the largest shareholders in DFS, holding between them 10.48 million ordinary shares representing over 10 percent of the issued share capital of DFS," the company added.
The fast-growing furniture maker announced another set off record profits, with pretax profit rising 18.6 percent to 31.1 million stg.
The placement was at a premium to Friday's closing price of 537.5 pence and during Monday share trade the market price leapt 21 pence to 558.5p by 1020 GMT.
